title: 📅 Free 2026 Emergency Preparedness Workshops in Los Altos Hills - NewsBreak
text:
13 hours ago The Los Altos Hills County Fire District is hosting its 2026 Be Ready Be Prepared (BRBP) workshop series to help residents get ready for emergencies. All classes take place at Los Altos Hills Town Hall from 10 AM to 12 PM .
Topics include:
Creating Emergency Plans – learn to build supply kits and stay informed. Fire Smart Landscaping – use native plants and maintain defensible space. Home Hardening & Zone 0 – reduce wildfire risk around your home. Build a First Aid Kit – refresh your kit and review basic first aid. Make a Go Bag – prepare for shelter-in-place or evacuation. Animal Preparedness – include pets in your emergency plan. Fire Extinguishers & Holiday Safety – celebrate safely and check alarms. Workshops are led by retired fire captains and local experts. Register at lahcfd.org/classes or email education@lahcfd.org for details.
More Info: https://www.lahcfd.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/...
